title: Boss: the Dockerfile reviewer
summary: Build the review bot your team runs on every Dockerfile: summary, stage checks and a cache-cost estimate.

steps.title: The review bot
steps.body: Pull requests that touch a Dockerfile get an automatic review comment. You are writing the parts of the bot: a one-line summary, a check that `COPY --from` points at real stages, and an estimate of how long a rebuild costs after a change.

steps.title: One-line summary
prompt: Write `string Summary(List<string> lines)` returning `"I instructions, S stages, runs: COMMAND"`.
- I counts instructions: non-blank lines not starting with `#` (no line continuations in this task).

- COMMAND is the final stage's ENTRYPOINT items followed by its CMD items (the **last** of each in the final stage wins; both reset at every `FROM`). Exec form `["a", "b"]` gives `a b`; shell form `CMD npm start` gives `/bin/sh -c npm start`. If the final stage has neither, COMMAND is `(inherited from base image)`.
Example: `12 instructions, 2 stages, runs: dotnet Api.dll`.
solution: if (keyword == "FROM") { stages++; entrypoint = null; cmd = null; }
string command = string.Join(" ", new[] { entrypoint, cmd }.Where(x => x != null));
template: Dojo.Eq(".NET multi-stage", "8 instructions, 2 stages, runs: dotnet Api.dll", Summary(new List<string> { "# build", "FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:9.0 AS build", "WORKDIR /src", "COPY . .", "RUN dotnet publish -o /out", "", "FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:9.0", "WORKDIR /app", "COPY --from=build /out .", "ENTRYPOINT [\"dotnet\", \"Api.dll\"]" }));

Dojo.Eq("last CMD wins, entrypoint plus cmd", "5 instructions, 1 stages, runs: curl --help", Summary(new List<string> { "FROM alpine:3.20", "RUN apk add curl", "ENTRYPOINT [\"curl\"]", "CMD [\"-v\"]", "CMD [\"--help\"]" }));
Dojo.Eq("shell form", "2 instructions, 1 stages, runs: /bin/sh -c npm start", Summary(new List<string> { "FROM node:22-alpine", "CMD npm start" }));
Dojo.Eq("commands reset at FROM", "3 instructions, 2 stages, runs: (inherited from base image)", Summary(new List<string> { "FROM node:22 AS build", "CMD [\"node\"]", "FROM nginx:1.27" }));
hints: Track `entrypoint` and `cmd` as nullable strings; set both to null on every FROM.
Write a helper that turns an argument string into its printable form for exec or shell form.

steps.title: Check COPY --from
prompt: Write `List<string> CheckStages(List<string> lines)` that validates stage references (lines numbered from 1):
- `FROM x AS name` where `name` was already used → `line N: duplicate stage name 'name'`

- `COPY --from=X` where X is not the name **or index** of an **earlier** stage → `line N: unknown stage 'X'`, unless X contains `:` or `/` (then it is an image reference like `--from=nginx:1.27`, which is allowed). A `COPY --from` that names the current stage itself is also unknown (a stage cannot copy from itself).
Return `ok` alone if there are no problems.
solution: string name = t.Length >= 4 && t[2].ToUpper() == "AS" ? t[3] : names.Count.ToString();
bool known = earlier.Contains(target) || (int.TryParse(target, out int index) && index >= 0 && index < earlier.Count);
template: Dojo.Eq("valid file", new List<string> { "ok" }, CheckStages(new List<string> { "FROM node:22 AS deps", "FROM node:22 AS build", "COPY --from=deps /app/node_modules ./node_modules", "FROM node:22-alpine", "COPY --from=build /app/dist ./dist", "COPY --from=nginx:1.27 /etc/nginx/nginx.conf /tmp/" }));

Dojo.Eq("typo in a stage name", new List<string> { "line 3: unknown stage 'biuld'" }, CheckStages(new List<string> { "FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:9.0 AS build", "FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:9.0", "COPY --from=biuld /out ." }));

Dojo.Eq("copy from a later stage or itself", new List<string> { "line 2: unknown stage 'final'", "line 4: unknown stage 'final'" }, CheckStages(new List<string> { "FROM alpine:3.20 AS build", "COPY --from=final /x /x", "FROM alpine:3.20 AS final", "COPY --from=final /y /y" }));

Dojo.Eq("indexes and duplicates", new List<string> { "line 2: duplicate stage name 'build'", "line 4: unknown stage '3'" }, CheckStages(new List<string> { "FROM golang:1.23 AS build", "FROM golang:1.23 AS build", "COPY --from=0 /a /a", "COPY --from=3 /b /b" }));
hints: The earlier stages are all names except the last (the current one).
An index is valid when it is less than the number of earlier stages.

steps.title: What will this rebuild cost?
prompt: Each instruction now carries how many seconds it takes when it is **not** cached: `"RUN dotnet restore|40"`. Write `int RebuildSeconds(List<string> steps, List<string> changed)` that returns the total seconds of the steps that will rebuild, using the cache rules from the layers lesson (the first `COPY` without `--from=` whose sources match a changed file misses, and every step from there on rebuilds; sources are the tokens between `COPY` and the destination, ignoring `--` flags; `.`/`./` match anything, `*.ext` matches by suffix, a path matches itself or files under it).
Then the reviewer can say: *"This change costs 52 s to rebuild; move the restore above COPY . . and it costs 12 s."*
solution: if (changed.Any(f => sources.Any(s => Matches(s, f)))) miss = true;
template: var dojoNaive = new List<string> { "FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:9.0|0", "WORKDIR /src|0", "COPY . .|2", "RUN dotnet restore|40", "RUN dotnet publish -o /out --no-restore|10" };

var dojoGood = new List<string> { "FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:9.0|0", "WORKDIR /src|0", "COPY Api.csproj .|1", "RUN dotnet restore|40", "COPY . .|2", "RUN dotnet publish -o /out --no-restore|10" };
Dojo.Eq("naive file, code edit", 52, RebuildSeconds(dojoNaive, new List<string> { "Program.cs" }));
Dojo.Eq("good file, code edit", 12, RebuildSeconds(dojoGood, new List<string> { "Program.cs" }));
Dojo.Eq("good file, new package", 53, RebuildSeconds(dojoGood, new List<string> { "Api.csproj" }));

Dojo.Eq("folder and flags", 31, RebuildSeconds(new List<string> { "FROM node:22|0", "COPY --chown=node:node package*.json ./|1", "RUN npm ci|60", "COPY --chown=node:node src ./src|1", "RUN npm run build|30" }, new List<string> { "src/app.ts" }));
hints: Split each step at its last `|` into the instruction and its seconds.
This is your `Rebuilt` logic with a running total instead of labels.
